title_en: A Framework for Japanese Language Education Using Persona-Based Local LLM Chatbots and AI Prompts: Focusing on the Cultivation of Critical AI Literacy and Learner Autonomy
kw_en: Japanese Language Education; Generative AI; Critical AI Literacy; Learner Autonomy; Persona-based Chatbot; 日本語教育; 生成AI; 批判的AIリタラシー; 学習者の自律性; ペルソナ型チャットボット
abstract_ko: 生成AIの急速な普及は外国語教育分野において新たな教育モデルの構築を急務としている。しかし、現状の日本語教育におけるAI活用は表層的な利用に留まり、人文系専攻者に求められる批判的リテラシーや学習者主導性の育成には至っていない。先行研究においてもAI固有の限界を教育的に活用し、学習者を受動的な消費者から能動的な創造者へと転換させる体系的なフレームワークが欠如している。 本研究は、こうした問題意識に基づき、「批判的AIリテラシー」と「学習者主導性」の育成を目的とした新たな日本語教育フレームワークを提案する。本モデルは「脱構築・批判」「適用・制御」「創造・省察」の3段階で構成され、AIの構造的欠陥の分析、Ollamaを用いたローカルLLMの構築と制御、RAG技術を用いたペルソナベース・チャットボットの制作を実践する。 大学の授業における実践の結果、学習者は技術的不安を克服し、受動的な消費者から能動的な設計者へと役割を転換させた。分析の結果、高度なプロンプトエンジニアリング能力とAIへの深く批判的な理解が育成されたことが確認された。本研究は、AIの弱点を教育的強みとして転換する体系的なモデルを提示し、AIを脱構築・制御・創造する力を通じて、人文系学習者に不可欠な批判的思考能力と主体性を育成できることを実証した。
abstract_en: The rapid integration of generative AI into education necessitates new pedagogical models. However, current applications in Japanese language education often remain superficial, failing to cultivate the critical literacy and autonomy required for humanities majors. Existing research lacks a systematic framework that addresses AI's limitations while empowering learners to transition from passive consumers to active creators. This study proposes a novel framework designed to foster Critical AI Literacy and Learner Autonomy. Structured in three stages—“Deconstruction & Critique,” “Application & Control,” and “Creation & Reflection”—the framework involves analyzing AI flaws, controlling local LLMs using Ollama, and creating persona-based chatbots using RAG techniques. Application in a university course demonstrated a significant transformation in learners, shifting their role to active designers. Analysis confirmed the cultivation of sophisticated prompt engineering skills and a critical understanding of AI. This research contributes a replicable model leveraging AI's weaknesses as strengths, demonstrating that empowering learners to deconstruct and create with AI fosters the high-level critical thinking essential for humanities students in the AI era.

title_ko: Developing a ChatGPT-based Teaching and Learning Model for High School Reading English Literature
title_en: Developing a ChatGPT-based Teaching and Learning Model for High School Reading English Literature
kw_ko: 챗지피티; 영미 문학 읽기; 수업 모형; 2022 개정 교육과정
kw_en: ChatGPT; Reading English Literature; instructional model; 2022 Revised National Curriculum
abstract_ko: This study aims to develop a ChatGPT-based instructional model for ‘High School Reading English Literature’, a career elective subject, aligning with the 2022 Revised National Curriculum, which promotes the integration of AI tools such as ChatGPT. With limited empirical research on the application of ChatGPT in English literature, this study is significant in bridging this gap by developing an instructional model in accordance with academic procedures. To address this, a needs survey was conducted among 33 high school teachers and 144 Jeonnam high school students to identify their perceptions of ChatGPT and Reading English Literature. An instructional model was then developed, and an expert group evaluated its validity. A four-hour pilot class was conducted, followed by a post-survey and post-interview to assess its effectiveness and gather pedagogical implications. The study reveals significant differences between teachers and students’ perceptions of Reading English Literature. The model was positively evaluated by the expert group, and the results of the post-survey and the post-interview further confirmed its efficacy, providing three main implications. The findings of this study addressed the issue of over-reliance on ChatGPT and reshaping students’ perceptions of Reading English Literature, as well as validating the effectiveness of ChatGPT in education.

title_ko: 인공지능(AI)기술을 활용한 중국어 학습지도안 개발
title_en: Development of Chinese Lesson Plan Utilizing AI Technology
kw_en: AI Technology; Chinese Lesson Plan; ChatGPT; GPTs; Pre-service teachers
abstract_ko: This study investigates how AI technology can be used to develop Chinese lesson plans and assist pre-service teachers in creating effective plans through ChatGPT’s GPTs feature. To facilitate this, the ‘Chinese Lesson Planner’ GPTs was developed, and pre-service teachers used it to create lesson plans. The GPTs offered support in modifying lesson formats, recommending teaching methods, developing assessments, providing cultural resources, correcting linguistic content, and translation. However, there were instances where the responses from GPTs were inaccurate or did not align with students’ levels, and some responses were difficult to obtain due to insufficient or excessive learning data. Despite these challenges, GPTs proved to be a powerful tool for streamlining the lesson plan creation process and supporting teachers’ creativity. It is essential, however, for teachers to verify the accuracy of the information provided by the GPTs and use their expertise and critical thinking to refine the lesson plans. Teachers must carefully review and adjust the AI-generated content to ensure that the essence of education is preserved and the quality of teaching is maintained. A collaborative relationship between AI and teachers is necessary to maximize AI’s efficiency and creativity. By doing so, teachers can focus on delivering customized education that addresses individual student needs. Ultimately, AI can help reduce teachers’ workload, improve the quality of education, and enable more effective and innovative teaching. Continuous research and development of AI technology are required to shape the future of education.

abstract_ko: 인공지능(Artificial Intelligence: AI) 기술의 발전으로 인해 언어 교육 분야에서도 AI 기반 언어 학습에 대한 관심이 점점 증가하고 있다. 그러나 관련 기술의 발전에도 불구하고 여전히 AI를 수업에 어떻게 적용할지에 대한 실제적인 방안은 확립되지 않고 있으며 이에 대한 효과성 검증도 충분하지 않은 실정이다. 이 논문에서는 국내 제 2외국어로서 스페인어 학습에서 ChatGPT와 같은 AI의 활용 방안에 대해 고찰하고자 한다. 구체적으로, ChatGPT를 통한 스페인어 구문 학습에 관한 몇 가지 가정적 상황들을 제시하고 ChatGPT가 생성한 답변에 대해 비판적으로 검토하고자 한다. 또한, ChatGPT의 활용에 따른 장단점 및 한계에 대해 논의하고, 스페인어 구문 학습에서 ChatGPT는 기존의 교실수업에서는 여러 여건상 실행하기 힘든 학습활동들을 보완할 수 있는 보조적 수단으로 활용될 수 있음을 제안하고자 한다. 즉, ChatGPT를 활용한 디지털 수업에서는 교수자의 적절한 개입을 통해 ChatGPT가 생성하는 정보의 정확성을 판별하고 데이터의 신뢰성을 검증하는데 있어 중요한 역할을 할 수 있다.
abstract_en: With the development of artificial intelligence (AI) technology, there is a growing interest in AI-based language learning in the field of language education. However, despite the advancement of related technologies, practical measures on how to apply AI to actual classes are still not established, and the effectiveness is not sufficiently verified. This paper aims to study the application of AI such as ChatGPT in learning Spanish as a second language in Korea. Specifically, I present several hypothetical situations for learning syntactic structures of Spanish through ChatGPT and critically examine the answers generated by ChatGPT. In addition, I discuss the advantages, disadvantages, and limitations of using ChatGPT, and suggest that ChatGPT can be used as a supplementary tool for learning syntactic structures of Spanish to complement traditional classroom instruction that may not be feasible in many situations. This means that in a digital classroom utilizing ChatGPT, appropriate intervention by the instructor can play an important role in determining the accuracy of the information generated by ChatGPT and verifying the reliability of the data.

title_en: Impact of Artificial Intelligence on International Chinese Language Education
kw_en: 国际汉语教育; 人工智能; 教学模式; 多模态教学; 学习者体验; International Chinese Language Education; Artificial Intelligence; Teaching Models / Instructional Models; Multimodal Instruction / Multimodal Pedagogy; Learner Experience
abstract_ko: 随着人工智能技术的快速发展, 其在全球语言教育领域中的应用不断深化, 国际汉语教育也因此迎来新的发展契机。本研究通过系统梳理人工智能技术的发展脉络, 分析其在国际汉语教育中的主要应用模式、教学模式变革与学习者体验优化等方面的影响。指出人工智能在语音评估、写作批改、学习资源生成、学习路径规划、多模态输入以及虚拟情境构建等领域具有显著优势, 推动国际汉语教学从传统的教师中心模式向人机协同、数据驱动与个性化教学模式转型。同时本研究也指出人工智能在技术适配性、学习者数据安全、算法偏差、教师技术能力以及教育公平性等方面仍面临重要挑战。展望未来, 人工智能将在多模态智能、人机协同教学与智能文化传播等方向进一步拓展其潜力。本研究对人工智能时代国际汉语教育的发展趋势进行了整体分析, 为相关研究与实践提供参考。
abstract_en: With the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI), its integration into global language education has accelerated significantly, creating new opportunities for the development of international Chinese language education. This study systematically reviews the evolution of AI technologies and examines their applications, impacts on instructional models, and contributions to learner experience within the field of Teaching Chinese as a Second/Foreign Language (TCSL). The analysis reveals that AI demonstrates notable advantages in areas such as speech assessment, automated writing feedback, content generation, adaptive learning pathway construction, multimodal input, and virtual immersive environments. These technologies collectively facilitate a shift from traditional teacher-centered classrooms to learner-centered, data-driven, and human-AI collaborative instructional paradigms. However, challenges persist, including technical limitations, insufficient learner corpora, issues of data privacy, potential algorithmic bias, teachers’ technological readiness, and concerns regarding educational equity. Looking forward, AI is expected to reinforce its role in multimodal intelligence, collaborative teaching systems, and AI-supported cultural transmission. This study provides a comprehensive examination of the transformative impact of AI on international Chinese education and offers insights for both academic research and pedagogical practice.

kw_ko: 생성 AI; 인공지능; 단어형성; 임시어; 실재어

abstract_ko: This article examines some issues in word formation from the perspective that words generated immediately by generative AI can also be studied in word formation theory. By applying both procedures of analysis/interpretation of existing words and formation/expression of new words, we observed that the generative AI represented by ChatGPT-4 understands and generates words in a very similar way to humans. Generative AI that engage in contextualized word analysis/formation based on encyclopedic knowledge produce answers that are comparable to humans and exceed expectations. Of course, the results of generative AI are not a direct “mirror” of human linguistic competence. But it’s clear that the technology is worth exploring as a tool for exploring human language abilities. At first glance, it may be considered that the questions and answers with the machines summarized in this article are only at the level of phenomenon description. However, while continuing to observe Generative AI’s abilities on (1) combination and substitution, (2) conceptualization and verbalization and (3) analysis and formation of metaphorical-based compound nouns discussed in Chapter 3, we can expect to gain a wealth of ideas for studying human language.

abstract_ko: <abstract lang="english">This study aims to design an elementary Chinese reading instruction model that facilitates learners’ linguistic and content schemata through Generative AI, structured according to the principle of constructive alignment. For this purpose, reading instruction was restructured based on schema theory, employing Generative AI as an educational tool to enhance meaning construction and cultural exploration. Following the principle of constructive alignment, the proposed model organically integrates learning outcomes, teaching-learning activities, and assessment. In the instructor-centered AI utilization stage, Generative AI was employed to generate and verify instructional materials, including vocabulary, sentence patterns, and cultural background knowledge. In the learner-centered AI utilization stage, students expanded their content schemata and engaged in critical AI utilization experiences through cultural inquiry and presentation activities. Additionally, process-based assessments and rubrics were designed to evaluate both the reading comprehension process and the ability to utilize and verify AI. This research redefines Generative AI as an educational mediator for meaning construction and critical thinking. By presenting a constructive alignment-based Chinese reading instruction model for schema activation, this study demonstrates the practical possibilities of AI-integrated education.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 생성형 AI를 활용하여 KSL 학습자를 위한 교과서 기반 맞춤형 읽기 자료를 개발하고, 그 교육적 활용 가능성을 탐색하는 데 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 공립학교 교사 36명을 대상으로 맞춤형 읽기 자료 개발 필요성에 관한 설문조사를 실시하고, Chat GPT가 생성한 읽기 자료 초안에 대한 수정 양상과 만족도를 분석하였다. 연구 결과, 교사들은 KSL 학습자의 교과 학습 지원을 위해 교과서 기반의 읽기 자료가 필요하며, 특히 텍스트 난도 조정과 이미지 활용이 중요하다고 인식하고 있었다. AI가 생성한 읽기 텍스트에 대해 교사들은 어휘와 문장 수준에서 단순화와 상세화 원리로 수정하였고, 학습 목표 달성을 위해 교과서 원문으로 재수정하거나 부연 설명을 추가하기도 하였다. 교사들은 AI가 생성한 텍스트 자료에 대해 중간 수준 이상의 만족도를 보였으나, 이미지 자료는 개선이 필요하다고 평가하였다. 이러한 결과는 생성형 AI가 KSL 학습자 맞춤형 자료 개발에 효율적 도구가 될 수 있으나, 양질의 자료 생성을 위해서는 교사의 AI 활용 역량 강화와 적절한 교육적 중재가 필수적임을 시사한다. 본 연구는 첨단 기술을 활용하여 KSL 학습자 맞춤형 교과 연계 교육 자료 개발을 위한 기초 연구로서, 향후 교육 현장에서 AI를 활용한 개별화 교육의 실천적 토대를 마련하였다는 점에서 의의가 있다.
abstract_en: The purpose of this study is to develop customized textbook-based reading materials for Korean as a Second Language (KSL) students using generative AI and to explore its educational applicability. A survey was conducted with 36 public school teachers regarding the development of customized reading materials, and the revisions and satisfaction levels concerning reading material drafts generated by ChatGPT were analyzed. The findings indicate that teachers recognize the necessity of textbook-based reading materials to support KSL students in their academic studies,emphasizing the importance of text difficulty adjustment and the incorporating images. Teachers revised AI-generated reading texts by applying principles of simplification and elaboration at the lexical and sentence levels and made additional modifications, such as re-editing based on the original textbook content or adding supplementary explanations, to achieve learning objectives. While teachers showed moderate to high satisfaction with AI-generated text materials, they assessed that the image resources required improvement. These results suggest that generative AI can serve as an efficient tool for developing customized materials for KSL students,but the production of high-quality materials necessitates enhanced teacher proficiency in AI utilization and appropriate educational interventions. This study provides foundational research on leveraging advanced technologies for the development of tailored, curriculum-linked educational materials for KSL students, establishing a practical basis for implementing individualized education with AI in future educational settings.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 중국의 대표적인 생성형 AI인 ERNIE Bot(文心一言)의 중국어 독해 능력을 HSK 독해 시험 문항을 통해 객관적으로 평가하고 분석하였다. 결과에 따르면, ERNIE Bot은 전반적으로 우수한 중국어 독해 능력을 보여주었으며, 사전 훈련 모델은 어휘 영역과 담화 영역에서 특히 높은 성능을 나타낸 반면, 미세 조정 모델은 문법과 연결 영역에서 유의미한 개선을 보였다. 또한 ERNIE Bot은 풍부한 문맥을 제공하는 긴 텍스트에서 가장 뛰어난 성능을 보였으며, 한 번에 받아들일 수 있는 프롬프트 길이도 대폭 늘어나서 HSK 영역별 시험 문항을 처리하는 데 충분히 성능을 발휘할 수 있음을 확인할 수 있었다. 그러나 ERNIE Bot은 기본 규칙에 대한 이해가 부족했으며, 짧은 문장 간의 논리적 관계를 파악하거나 단독으로 제공된 문장에 대한 독해 능력이 상대적으로 부족했다. 이러한 한계를 극복하려면 프롬프트 설계와 함께 교육 전문가의 적극적인 참여가 필요하다. 본 연구의 의의는 중국 생성형 AI의 중국어 독해 능력을 체계적으로 분석하여, 향후 중국어 교육 및 평가 분야에서 AI 기술의 활용 가능성을 제시하는 데 있다. 또한, 사전훈련 모델과 미세조정 모델의 성능을 비교 분석함으로써, ERNIE Bot의 학습 능력과 개선 가능성을 확인하였으며, 이의 장단점을 분석함으로써, 향후 중국어 교육에서의 활용 방안과 개선 방향을 제시하였다. 향후 연구에서는 다양한 중국어 생성형 AI 모델들 간의 비교 연구, 실제 중국어 교육 현장에서의 적용 사례 연구, 그리고 ERNIE Bot의 한계를 보완하기 위한 방법론적 연구에 초점을 맞춰야 할 것이다. 결론적으로, ERNIE Bot은 중국어 독해 능력에서 높은 수준의 성능을 보여주었으며, 특히 미세조정을 통한 성능 개선 가능성이 확인되었다. 이는 향후 중국어 교육 분야에서 AI 기술의 활용 가능성을 크게 높여주는 결과로, 앞으로 더욱 심도 있는 연구와 실제 적용을 통해 중국어 교육의 질적 향상을 기대할 수 있을 것이다.
abstract_en: This study evaluated the Chinese reading comprehension abilities of ERNIE Bot, a leading Chinese generative AI, using HSK reading test items. Results showed that ERNIE Bot demonstrates excellent overall Chinese reading comprehension skills, with the pre-trained model excelling in vocabulary and discourse domains, while the fine-tuned model showed significant improvements in grammar and cohesion areas. ERNIE Bot performed best with longer texts providing ample context, and its recently expanded prompt length capacity allows for inputting comprehensive HSK test items across various domains. The research's significance lies in its systematic analysis of a Chinese AI's reading comprehension abilities, suggesting potential applications in Chinese language education and assessment. By comparing pre-trained and fine-tuned models, the study verified ERNIE Bot's learning capacity and improvement potential. However, ERNIE Bot showed limitations in understanding basic test-taking rules, logical relationships between short sentences, and comprehension of isolated sentences. Overcoming these limitations requires careful prompt design and involvement of education experts. Future research should focus on comparative studies of various Chinese AI models, practical application studies in educational settings, and methodological research to address ERNIE Bot's limitations. In conclusion, ERNIE Bot demonstrated high-level performance in Chinese reading comprehension, with potential for improvement through fine-tuning, promising qualitative advancements in Chinese language education through further research and practical applications.

title_ko: AI图画书融入汉语词汇教学：模型构建与可行性分析
title_en: Integration of AI-Enhanced Picture Books into Chinese Vocabulary Teaching: Model Construction and Feasibility Analysis
kw_en: Generative artificial intelligence; AI picture book-enhanced vocabulary teaching model; L2 Chinese vocabulary learning; Multimodal output; Task-based vocabulary instruction; Feasibility analysis
abstract_ko: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly penetrating the field of language education. This development has opened new avenues for addressing a longstanding challenge in university-level Chinese vocabulary instruction, namely abundant input coupled with insufficient output and weak transferability. Adopting a design-based rather than purely empirical approach, this study focuses on Korean university students majoring in Chinese at the HSK 3–4 proficiency level and proposes an integrated AI-enhanced picture book vocabulary teaching model. The model is grounded in research on AI-assisted vocabulary learning, task-based vocabulary instruction, and multimodal and generative learning theories. Unlike many existing studies that concentrate on early literacy or AI-assisted writing in English, this study targets L2 Chinese vocabulary learning in higher education. Centered on themes such as traditional Chinese festivals, the tasks guide learners to create audio picture books using tools like ChatGPT, AI image generators, and text-to-speech software. The model combines traditional vocabulary explanation with a spiral task cycle comprising five stages: input, application, multimodal output, feedback, and internalization. To minimize over-reliance on AI-generated content and highlight learners’ authentic linguistic efforts, a comprehensive rubric and a “Language Effort Rating Form” are developed and employed. These tools integrate product-oriented and process-focused assessment approaches, thereby making learners’ language investment and revision processes visible. The study then analyzes the model’s feasibility from three dimensions: alignment with teaching objectives, technological accessibility, and teacher–learner readiness. It further provides a detailed lesson plan for the “Dragon Boat Festival (Duanwu Festival)” unit, which serves to illustrate classroom implementation procedures and task workflows. The analysis indicates that the model is highly practical under current university teaching conditions and holds significant potential for broader application. As a conceptual and design-oriented study, it offers a replicable classroom paradigm and design framework for integrating generative AI into vocabulary instruction, while also outlining clear directions for future quasi-experimental studies and classroom-based research.

title_ko: AI 일한 번역에서의 정도부사 처리 양상과 교육 실천 방안 모색 - ChatGPT를 중심으로 -
title_en: Processing Patterns of Degree Adverbs in AI Japanese–Korean Translation and Pedagogical Implications - Focusing on ChatGPT -
kw_en: Japanese degree adverbs; Korean Correspondence Patterns; Translation Patterns; Pedagogical Implications; 日本語の程度副詞; ChatGPT; 韓国語の対応 様相; 翻訳の処理様相; 教育実践の方案
abstract_ko: 本稿では、ChatGPTによる日韓翻訳を中心に、程度副詞の処理様相を考察した。そ の結果は以下のようである。 韓国語に対応する場合、｢あまり｣と｢とても｣を除く程度副詞は、主に｢꽤(kkawe)｣ に統一される傾向を示す。しかし、プロンプトの違いによる差異も見られ、｢とても｣ ｢なかなか｣｢だいぶ｣はプロンプト4において、｢あまり｣｢かなり｣｢けっこう｣｢ずいぶん ｣はプロンプト3において意味の分布が拡張される。 翻訳における語順の変化は、ChatGPTと人間翻訳の｢なかなか｣においては生じず、 ｢あまり｣と｢だいぶ｣において最も多く見られる。これは、この副詞が他の副詞に比べ 文頭に出現しやすい構文的特徴によるものである。 添加の現象は人間翻訳よりもChatGPTにおいて多く現れ、特に｢かなり｣における発 生が著しいことが分かった。これは｢かなり｣が名詞を修飾する傾向によるものであ り、またプロンプト4において主に現れることから、副詞と表現を中心に翻訳する場 合、程度副詞の意味の補強が活発に行われることが分かる。 ChatGPTにおける変用は｢だいぶ｣を除くすべての副詞において確認されるが、人間 翻訳と比較するとその頻度は極めて低かった。ただし、ChatGPTの変用が一部であると はいえ、こういう傾向は人間翻訳に同じような意味深い変化として注目すべきである。 程度副詞自体の誤訳は、ChatGPTと人間翻訳のいずれにおいても見られず、｢あま り｣｢かなり｣｢だいぶ｣の含む文において他の要素による誤用が一部確認される。しかし その全体的な比率は極めて低く、翻訳の正確性は相当の水準であることが示される。
abstract_en: This study examines how degree adverbs are processed in Japanese–Korean translation by ChatGPT, and the results are as follows. In terms of correspondence with Korean, most degree adverbs-except ‘あまり(amari)’ and ‘とても(totemo)’-tend to be rendered uniformly as ‘꽤’(kkwae). However, differences according to the prompt was observed: ‘とても/なかなか(nakanaka)’, and ‘だいぶ(daibu)’ expanded in Prompt 4, whereas that of ‘あまり/かなり(kanari)/けっこう (kekkou)’, and ‘ずいぶん(zuibun)’ expanded in Prompt 3. In terms of word order variation, no changes occurred in ‘なかなか’ in either ChatGPT‘s or human translations, while ‘あまり’ and ‘だいぶ’ commonly showed the highest frequency of variation in both. This is attributed to a syntactic characteristic that two adverbs appear frequently at the beginning of a sentence. Additions occurred more frequently in ChatGPT’s translations than in human translations. Particularly the frequency was high in ‘かなり’, which can be attributed to its syntactic tendency to modify nouns. Also this phenomenon appeared mainly in Prompt 4, indicating that the semantic reinforcement of degree adverbs occur more actively when translation focuses on adverbs and expressions. Transformations occurred in all adverbs except ‘だいぶ’ in ChatGPT‘s translations, although their frequency was much lower than in human ones. However, despite the limited transformations in ChatGPT, this tendency carries significant implications as it represents a meaningful shift toward human translations. No mistranslations of the degree adverbs themselves were observed in either ChatGPT’s or human translations, although misuse caused by other elements occurred in embedded clauses containing ‘あまり’, ‘かなり’, and ‘だいぶ’. Nevertheless, the overall proportion of such errors was very low, showing a high level of translation accuracy.

title_ko: Integrating ChatGPT into College English Learning : Effects on Language Anxiety, Self-Regulated Learning, and Learner Perceptions
title_en: Integrating ChatGPT into College English Learning : Effects on Language Anxiety, Self-Regulated Learning, and Learner Perceptions
kw_en: ChatGPT; language anxiety; self-regulated learning; college English
abstract_ko: This study examined the effects of integrating ChatGPT into college English classes over one semester, focusing on changes in students’ perceptions of ChatGPT, language anxiety, and self-regulated learning strategies, as well as the relationships among these variables after integration. Thirty-seven first-year students participated in ChatGPT-supported reading and writing courses. From Weeks 3 to 13, students used ChatGPT to explore vocabulary meanings, construct sentences using newly learned expressions, and engage in text-based discussions on weekly topics. Pre-post questionnaires were administered, consisting of three sections: (1) English learning anxiety, (2) self-regulated learning, and (3) perceptions of ChatGPT. Adopting a pre-post questionnaire design, the study employed paired-samples t-tests and correlation analyses to assess changes and associations among the variables. The findings showed that students developed more positive attitudes toward ChatGPT as a language learning tool. Correlation analyses indicated strong to moderate within-domain relationships after ChatGPT use, whereas cross-domain correlations were relatively weak. These results underscore the need for explicit pedagogical guidance to reduce language anxiety and strengthen self-regulated learning in L2 contexts.

title_ko: 6세 아동의 읽기 유창성 예측 의사결정나무 모델: 언어 및 초기 문해능력, 말소리능력, 성별, 연령, 사회경제적 지위를 중심으로
title_en: Predicting Reading Fluency Groups Using Decision Trees in 6-Year-Old Children: Focusing on Language, Early Literacy, Speech Sound Ability, Gender, Age, and SES
kw_ko: 한국아동패널연구(PSKC); 읽기 유창성; 의사결정나무 모델; 말소리 조음능력; 문장 따라말하기

abstract_ko: 배경 및 목적: 본 연구에서는 6세 학령전 아동들의 한글 읽기 유창성 수준과 읽기 관련 개별변수들의 관계를 우선 살펴보고, 개별변수를 적용한 모델이 읽기 유창성 수준을 예측하는 것이 유용한지 살펴보았다. 방법: 한국아동패널연구(PSKC, Panel Study on Korean Children) 6세 대상자 1,343명을 대상으로 읽기 유창성 22개 예측 변수를 CHAID (Chi square Automatic Interaction Detector) 알고리즘을 적용한 의사결정나무 분석(Decision Tree Analysis, DTA)을 실시하였다. 결과: 일반(성별, 월령), SES (월 평균 가구 소득, 엄마의 학력), 말소리 및 인지언어 측정변수(조음평정치, 모방오류어절지수), 학업능력과 인지(언어 및 문해능력, 주의력결핍) 특성에 대한 개별 변수에 대해 살펴본 결과, 월 평균 가구 소득 변수를 제외한 측정변수가 읽기 유창성 집단에 따라 유의미한 차이를 보이는 것으로 나타났다. 그리고 읽기 유창성에 유의미한 영향을 미치는 변수는 7가지 변수(엄마가 평가하였을 때 아동이 혼자서 간단한 책을 스스로 읽는 정도, 월령, 성별, 모방오류어절지수, 말소리 조음평정치 수준, 담임교사가 평가하였을 때 한글 자음과 모음을 쉽고 빠르게 말하는 수준, 담임교사가 평가하였을 때 단어의 운율을 맞추어 말하는 정도)인 것으로 나타났다. 논의 및 결론: 읽기 유창성 DTA 모델은 초등학교 입학 예정 대상자들의 읽기 유창성을 구분하여 읽기지도가 추가적으로 필요한 대상자를 선별하는 모델로서 적용할 수 있을 것이다. 그리고 읽기 유창성에는 이미 선행연구로 알려져 있는 아동 개별 및 환경요인인 엄마의 학력과 문해환경, 성별과 연령, 자음과 모음 낱글자에 대한 읽기와 음운인식 이외에 ‘말소리 조음능력과 모방오류어절지수’가 포함됨을 알 수 있었다.
abstract_en: Objectives: The purpose of this study was to examine the relationship between the level of Korean reading fluency and individual variables related to reading in children before the age of 6, and whether it is useful for the model to which individual variables are applied to predict the level of reading fluency. Methods: In this study, 343 6-year-old subjects of PSKC (Panel Study on Korean Children) in this study, DTA was conducted using the CHAID algorithm. Results: As a result of examining individual variables for general (gender, monthly age), SES, speech, and cognitive language measurement variables (level of speech sound disorder, word error index in sentence repetition), academic and cognitive skill (language and literacy, attention deficit); the measurement variables showed significant differences depending on the reading fluency group. In addition, seven variables significantly affected reading fluency (Reads first-grade books independently when evaluated by a mother, age, gender, word error index in sentence repetition, level of speech sound disorder, and reading all the consonants and vowels of Hangul when evaluated by a homeroom teacher, making rhyme words when evaluated by a homeroom teacher). Conclusion: The reading fluency DTA model can be applied as a model for selecting subjects who need additional reading guidance by classifying the reading fluency of those who are scheduled to enter elementary school. In addition to reading and phonological recognition of children’s individual and environmental factors already known in previous studies; the maternal educational level, gender, and age, consonants & vowels, reading ability, and word error index in sentence repetition were included.

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 인공지능기술 기반 영어 말하기 연습 시스템인 EBS AI펭톡의 초등영어교육에서의 역할및 활용 방안을 탐색하는데 그 목적이 있다. 이를 위해 AI펭톡 활용에 관한 사용자의 인식 조사를 목적으로 AI펭톡 활용에 대한 전반적인 인식 및 만족도를 비롯하여 여섯 가지 항목으로 문항에 따라 리커트 6점 척도, 복수 문항 선택형, 주관식 단답형으로 설문지를 제작하였다. 교사, 학생, 학부모의 집단별특성에 따라 서로 다른 설문 문항을 구성하였으며, EBSe 웹사이트에 설문지를 게시하여 전국의 AI펭톡 사용자들이 자발적으로 온라인 설문에 참여하는 방식으로 진행되었다. 설문조사에 응답한 학생, 학부모, 교사의 응답 결과를 바탕으로 크게 AI펭톡에 대한 역할 인식, AI펭톡의 활용 현황, AI펭톡 개선요구 분석 및 활용 증대 방안을 제시하였다. 연구 결과 첫째, AI펭톡에 대한 역할 인식을 조사한 결과교사는 AI펭톡을 학습 상태 점검 도구 및 대화상대자로 인식한 반면, 학생과 학부모는 학습도우미와동기유발 도구로 인식하는 경향이 나타났다. 둘째, AI펭톡의 활용 현황을 분석한 결과, 교사는 자기주도학습 측면에서 더 높은 활용도를 보였다. 정규 수업에서 AI펭톡을 활용하는 경우에는 한 단원에 한차시를 활용하는 빈도수가 가장 높았으며, 주로 연습 활동과 마무리 활동에서 가장 많이 활용된다는 것으로 나타났다. 한편, 학생과 교사가 가장 많이 활용하는 학습영역을 비교하고 분석한 결과 두 집단 모두 토픽월드와 스피킹을 집중적으로 활용하였으며, 렛츠톡과 스캔잇은 교사가 사용을 주도하기보다는학생이 스스로 사용하는 것으로 나타났다. 셋째, AI펭톡의 개선 방안에 대해 분석한 결과 학생들은 음성인식 개선, 재미있는 활동(게임)추가, 참치캔을 활용한 다양한 활동 기능 추가, 매주 기록이 초기화되지 않도록 개선 등의 의견을 제시하였다. 교사들은 단원별 학습 콘텐츠를 쉽게 찾을 수 있도록 앱을 구성할 필요성, 학생들의 사용 기록을 종합적으로 보기 쉽게 나타내는 것이 필요하다는 의견을 제시하였다. 마지막으로 학부모의 접근성을 확대하기 위한 방안에 대한 언급을 한 것으로 분석되었다. 한편, AI 펭톡을 사용하지 않는 교사들은 교실내 학생 수준 차로 인한 활용의 어려움, 기자재 환경의 열악함, 교실 수업보다는 가정학습에 효과적이라는 의견 등을 제시하였다. 이와 같은 본 연구 결과는 EBS가 AI펭톡의 내용과 운영 구성을 보다 효과적이고 효율적으로 개선하고, 이를 기반으로 초등영어교육 현장에서 훨씬 더 유용하게 활용하고, 더 많이 사용할 수 있도록 하는 데 도움을 줄 것으로 본다.
abstract_en: This study examines the educational role of AI PengTalk, an English-speaking system powered by artificial intelligence (AI) technology, and proposes strategies for its use in elementary English education. A questionnaire was administered to examine the perceptions of AI PengTalk users (students, teachers, and parents), and the data were analyzed both quantitatively and qualitatively. The findings are as follows. First, students and teachers had more favorable perceptions of AI PengTalk than parents. Second, when teachers used AI PengTalk, they encouraged students to engage in more active use of it, attempted to scaffold the students’ learning, and designed lessons that seamlessly utilized the application. Third, regarding user preferences for the activities offered within the application, both students and teachers reported that they frequently used the “Topic World” and “Speaking” activities but rarely used the “Scan It” or “School Talk” activities. Lastly, with regard to suggestions for improving the application, the student comments focused on enhancing voice recognition capabilities and developing additional activities. The teacher comments, on the other hand, were more related with the application’s user interface and user experience. The researchers draws conclusions and makes several recommendations in light of these findings.

title_ko: 중국인 학습자의 ChatGPT를 활용한 PBL 기반 한국어 말하기 학습효과
title_en: A study on the learning effects of Korean speaking through PBL using ChatGPT for Chinese learners
kw_ko: 챗GPT; 문제중심학습; 한국어 말하기 학습효과; 중국인 학습자
kw_en: ChatGPT; PBL; learning effects of Korean speaking; Chinese learners
abstract_ko: This study examines the effects of AI ChatGPT-based Problem-Based Learning (PBL) on the Korean speaking abilities of Chinese learners at intermediate and advanced levels. Eighteen learners participated via Zoom, and learning outcomes were assessed using pre- and post-surveys. Results showed significant improvement for intermediate learners, but little change for advanced learners. Sub-factor analysis indicated that advanced learners improved in anxiety and satisfaction, while intermediate learners showed broader gains in self-efficacy, engagement, anxiety, and satisfaction, with self-efficacy improving most. Feedback revealed that intermediate learners benefited from grammar correction and presentation confidence but struggled with complex responses and reliance on AI. Advanced learners reported cognitive and expressive gains but noted weak logical flow and limited cultural understanding. Overall, ChatGPT-based PBL speaking lessons were more effective for intermediate than advanced learners.

title_ko: 학부생 번역자는 기계번역 포스트에디팅 가이드라인을 어떻게 이해하는가? 중국어-한국어 파파고 기계번역을 중심으로
title_en: How Do Undergraduate Trainee Translators Interpret Machine Translation Post-Editing Guidelines? A Case of the Chinese-to-Korean Papago Translation
kw_ko: 기계번역 포스트에디팅 가이드라인; 회고인터뷰; 학부생 번역; 중한 번역; 네이버 파파고
kw_en: machine translation post-editing guidelines; retrospective interview; undergraduate trainee translator; Chinese-to-Korean translation; Naver Papago
abstract_ko: This study aims to investigate how undergraduate trainee translators interpret guidelines for Chinese-to-Korean machine translation post-editing. To this end, 15 undergraduate trainee translators were asked to perform Chinese-to-Korean machine translation post-editing with two different types of text (a report and a speech). The machine translation engine used was NAVER Papago. After that, retrospective interviews were conducted with four students who had written commentaries on their own translations. Results show that some explanations of syntax and punctuation needed to be omitted, while some explanations of lexis needed to be revised to the level that students can understand. It was also found that students needed not only theoretical descriptions of editing criteria but examples of how the criteria can be applied in practice. It was thus necessary to add specific and detailed examples to items that students felt confused, such as style and consistency.

title_ko: AI 기반 대화형 한국어 학습의 효과성 연구
title_en: A Study on the Effectiveness of AI-Based Korean Conversational Learning
kw_en: AI-based Learning; Korean Language Education; Conversational AI; Mixed-Effects Model; EdTech Platform
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 인공지능(AI) 기반 한국어 대화 학습의 효과성을 실증적으로 검증하는 것을 목적으로 한다. 기존의 AI 언어 학습 연구가 주로 소규모 표본과 설문 중심의 인식 조사에 머물렀다면, 본 연구는 비상교육의 ‘AI Speak 2.0’ 솔루션에서 수집된 실제 학습 로그 데이터를 활용하여 반복 학습이 학습자의 발화 능력에 미치는 누적적 효과를 분석하였다. 연구 대상은 외국인 한국어 학습자 3,800여 명의 대화 데이터를 기반으로 하였으며, 발화량(단어 수)과 문장 완성도를 주요 분석 지표로 설정하였다. 혼합효과모형(Mixed-Effects Models)을 적용하여 개인차를 통제한 결과, 반복적인 AI 대화 학습이 학습자의 발화량과 문장 완성도를 모두 향상시키는 유의미한 효과를 보였다. 특히 초기 학습 단계에서 발화량 증가가 두드러졌고, 학습이 지속됨에 따라 문장 구조의 완성도와 효율성이 강화되는 단계적 발달 양상이 확인되었다. 이러한 결과는 AI 기반 대화 학습이 학습자의 실제 말하기 능력을 양적·질적으로 향상시키는 효과적인 교수·학습 도구임을 시사한다. 본 연구는 실제 학습 로그 데이터를 활용하여 AI 한국어 교육의 학습 효과를 객관적으로 검증하였다는 점에서 의의가 있으며, 향후에는 학습자 수준, 학습 유형 등 변인을 고려한 장기적 종단 연구가 필요함을 제안한다.
abstract_en: This study aimed to verify the effectiveness of empirical artificial intelligence (AI)-based learning of conversational Korean. While prior research on AI language learning has relied mainly on small samples or perception-based surveys, this study analyzed the cumulative effects of repeated practice using real learning log data collected from Visang Education's AI Speak 2.0 platform. The dataset contained conversation logs from approximately 3,800 foreign learners of Korean, with word count and sentence completion rate set as the main indicators of speaking performance. Mixed-effects models were applied to control for individual differences, and the results showed that repeated AI-driven conversation practice significantly improved both the quantity and quality of the learners' speech. Learners demonstrated a sharp increase in word production in the early stages of learning, followed by gradual improvements in sentence structure and communicative efficiency as practice continued. These findings suggest that AI-based conversational systems function as effective instructional tools that enhance learners' speaking abilities in both quantitative and qualitative dimensions. This study is meaningful in that it provides objective evidence of learning effectiveness using real behavioral data rather than self-reported measures. Future research should conduct long-term longitudinal analyses that take into account learner proficiency and learning patterns.

title_ko: DeepSeek在汉语学习者偏误中的纠错表现 - 基于《全球汉语中介语语料库》的人机对比研究 -
title_en: The Performance of DeepSeek in Correcting Errors of Chinese Language Learners - A Human-AI Comparative Study Based on the Global Chinese Interlanguage Corpus -
kw_ko: 생성형 AI; 중국어 학습자; 오류 수정; 중간언어; 코퍼스
kw_en: DeepSeek; Generative AI; Chinese Language Learners; Error Correction; Interlanguage; Corpus
abstract_ko: 본 연구는 DeepSeek가 한국인 중국어 학습자의 작문 오류를 수정하는 데 있어 어떠한 양상과 특징을 보이는지 분석하고, 이를 인간 교사와 비교한 연구이다. 이를 위해 글로벌 중국어 중간언어 코퍼스에서 한국인 학습자의 오류 문장을 무작위로 추출하여 DeepSeek-R1 모델과 인간 교사의 수정 결과를 분석하였다. 주요 연구 결과는 다음과 같다. DeepSeek는 재현율(Recall, 95.86%) 면에서 인간 교사(84.83%)보다 우수하여 학습자의 오류를 거의 놓치지 않고 찾아내는 높은 민감도를 보였다. 그러나 정확도(Precision)는 49.47%로 인간 교사(85.42%)에 비해 현저히 낮았는데, 이는 오류가 없는 부분까지 수정하는 과도 교정 현상이 빈번했기 때문이다. DeepSeek는 오타 수정 및 어휘 오류 식별에 강점이 있으며, 문장을 더 문어체적이고 격식 있게 다듬는 경향이 있다. 반면, 인간 교사는 최소 수정 원칙을 준수하며 학습자의 본래 의도와 어조를 최대한 유지하는 신중함을 보였다. DeepSeek는 대규모 데이터를 빠르게 처리하고 수정하는 데 유용하며, 인간 교사는 문맥에 맞는 자연스러운 표현과 교육적 관점에서의 정확한 피드백을 제공하는 데 탁월하다. 결론적으로 인공지능과 인간 교사의 협력은 중국어 교육 현장에서 수정의 효율성과 정확성을 동시에 높일 수 있는 실질적인 방안이 될 수 있다.
abstract_en: This study analyzes the patterns and characteristics of DeepSeek in correcting writing errors made by Korean learners of Chinese and provides a comparative analysis with human teachers. For this purpose, error-containing sentences from Korean learners were randomly extracted from the Global Chinese Interlanguage Corpus, and the correction results of the DeepSeek-R1 model were compared against those of human teachers. The key research findings are as follows. DeepSeek demonstrated superior performance in terms of recall (95.86%) compared to human teachers (84.83%), showing high sensitivity in identifying almost all learner errors. However, its precision was significantly lower at 49.47%, compared to 85.42% for human teachers, due to frequent over-correction—modifying parts of the sentence that were originally error-free. DeepSeek showed strengths in correcting typos and identifying lexical errors, with a tendency to refine sentences into a more formal and written style. In contrast, human teachers adhered to the principle of minimum revision, exercising caution to preserve the learner's original intent and tone as much as possible. While DeepSeek is highly effective for rapidly processing and correcting large-scale data, human teachers excel at providing natural expressions suited to the context and accurate feedback from an educational perspective. In conclusion, the collaboration between AI and human teachers can serve as a practical approach to simultaneously enhance the efficiency and accuracy of error correction in Chinese language education.

title_ko: 한영 기계번역 발전 현황에 대한 문헌연구
title_en: A Review of the Literature on Korean-English Machine Translation
kw_en: Google Translate; Korean-English Translation; Machine Translation; Papago
abstract_ko: 인공지능이 우리의 일상생활에 끼치는 막강한 영향은 이제 더 이상 새로운 이야기가 아니다. 영어교육에 있어서도 인공지능은 다양한 종류의 도구를 제공하고 있다. 본 연구에서는 최근 영어교육의도구로 부각되고 있는 번역기와 관련된 문헌 연구를 통해 한영 기계번역 연구의 동향과 교육적 시사점을 살펴보고자 한다. 문헌 연구의 대상은 KCI(Korea Citation Index)에 등재된 논문 중에서 인공신경망기반 기계번역(Neural Machine Translation)이 본격적으로 시작된 2016년 이후 출판된 한영 기계번역 관련 논문으로 한정하였다. 최종 분석 대상 논문 37편의 내용을 분석하여 다음과 같은결론을 얻었다. 첫째, 한영 기계번역 논문의 가장 인기 있는 연구 주제는 14편의 논문에서 연구된 번역기의 정확성에 관한 것이었다. 구글번역기(Google Translate)와 네이버파파고(Naver Papago)의번역 정확성은 거의 비슷한 것으로 나타났다. 둘째, 한영 번역의 원천어(Source Text)인 한국어의 언어적 요소의 분석에서는 특정 요소가 집중적인 연구 대상은 아니었으며 격조사, 수동태, 문장부호 등전부 9가지 요소로 다양하게 나타났다. 또한 한국어의 번역 텍스트 또한 특정 종류에 집중되지 않고, 속담, 소설, 드라마 등 전부 11가지로 다양했다. 셋째, 기계번역의 발전 가능성과 영어교육에의 시사점에 대해 논의했다. 분석 대상 논문에 제시된 번역 결과와 최근 번역 결과의 비교를 통해 기계번역의단점과 장점을 동시에 볼 수 있었다. 번역기의 부정확한 결과물을 개선하는 과정인 후편집(MTPE: Machine Translation Post-Editing) 관련 논문이 7편 있었으며, 대부분 대학에서의 영작 교육에 후편집을 적용하는 것이었다. 또한 대학에서의 영어교육에 번역기를 활용하는 경우, 단점도 있었지만 긍정적인 결과가 더 많은 것으로 나타났다. 기계번역의 정확도는 앞으로 더욱 높아질 것이며, 영어교육현장, 특히 영작문 지도에 있어서 번역기가 중요한 도구가 될 것임은 더욱더 분명하다.
abstract_en: Today, artificial intelligence (AI) influences every aspect of our daily lives more significantly than ever before. English education is no exception. AI provides many useful tools in teaching and learning English, such as AI chatbots, metaverse, virtual reality, augmented reality, and machine translation. These tools are changing the traditional methods of English education in significant ways. This paper attempts to review the literature on Korean–English machine translation. The literature under review was selected from the Korea Citation Index for the 2016–2022 period. A total of 37 papers were analyzed to determine (1) recent trends in the studies of Korean–English machine translation, (2) the kinds of linguistic aspects and texts of Korean (as a source language) that are studied, and (3) the current limitations and prospects of Korean–English machine translation. The main results were as follows: First, the most popular topic of research was the accuracy of translation machines. The two main translation machines (Google Translate and Naver Papago) showed similar translation accuracy. Second, as for linguistic aspects of Korean, nine aspects, including particles, passives, and punctuation marks, were studied; no particular aspect was the focus of the studies. Similarly, 11 types of Korean texts were studied, including proverbs, novels, and dramas, but no particular text type was the focus of the studies. Third, both current limitations and prospects were found in the studies of Korean– English machine translation. The current study concludes that with the development of AI, the translation machine will certainly be a very effective tool in English education.

title_ko: 생성형 AI 접목 팀 기반 글쓰기 모듈의 설계·개발과 효과 분석 - 단계별 프롬프트 템플릿과 성찰일지 기반 접근

abstract_ko: 본 연구는 교양필수 <글쓰기와 표현> 수업의 팀 기반 사회문제 리포트 과제에 생성형 AI를 접목한 3-6주차(총 4주) 단계별 글쓰기 모듈을 설계·개발하고 AI를 ‘초안 대체’가 아닌 점검·수정·보완을 위한 협업 도구로 위치시킨 수업 설계 운영 결과를 바탕으로 관찰된 성과와 잔존과제를 분석하는 데 목적이 있다. 연구 대상은 수도권 C 대학교 수강생 69명(분반 A 35명, 분반 B 34명)이며 팀 단위로 개요, 서론, 본론, 결론을 단계적으로 산출했다. 각 단계에서 프롬프트 템플릿을 적용해 구조·독자·근거·문체를 점검하고 팀 토론을 거쳐 ‘선별적 반영’을 수행하도록 운영했으며 성찰일지와 사전·사후 설문 및 오픈형 설문을 수집해 기술통계와 서술적 내용으로 해석하였다. 사전 조사에서 AI 사용 경험은 A 분반 81.3%, B 분반 74.3%로 높았으나 윤리·출처 인지는 A 분반 40.6%, B 분반 54.3%로 낮게 나타났다. 사후 조사에서는 AI 활용의 자연스러움(A 87.5%, B 88.2%), 학습 효율(A 90.6%, B 88.2%), 수업 만족·향후 활용 의지(A 96.9%, B 94.1%)가 높게 보고된 반면 윤리 이해·실천은 A 53.1%, B 60.6%로 상대적으로 낮았다. 또한 성찰일지 분석에서 AI 활용 기능은 개요의 발상·구조화에서 서론 요건 점검, 본론의 근거·논증 보강, 결론의 요약·문체 편집으로 이동했으며 AI 반영은 전반적으로 ‘부분 반영’이 우세하되 최종 단계에서 고의존과 최소 활용이 함께 관찰되었다.
abstract_en: This study aims to design and develop a stepwise writing module (Weeks 3-6; four weeks) that integrates generative AI into a team-based social-issue report assignment in the general education required course Writing and Expression, and to analyze the outcomes and remaining challenges of an instructional design that positions AI not as a substitute for drafting but as a collaborative tool for checking, revising, and refining texts. The participants were 69 students at C University in the Seoul metropolitan area (Section A: 35, Section B: 34), who produced an outline, introduction, body, and conclusion in stages as a team. At each stage, prompt templates were applied to review structure, audience orientation, evidence, and style; teams then engaged in discussion to implement the principle of “selective adoption.” Data included reflective journals and pre-/post-tests along with open-ended surveys, which were interpreted through descriptive statistics and descriptive content analysis. In the pre-survey, AI use experience was high (Section A: 81.3%, Section B: 74.3%), whereas awareness of ethics and source use was low (Section A: 40.6%, Section B: 54.3%). In the post-survey, perceived naturalness of AI use (A: 87.5%, B: 88.2%), learning efficiency (A: 90.6%, B: 88.2%), and class satisfaction and intention for future use (A: 96.9%, B: 94.1%) were reported as high, while ethics understanding and practice remained relatively low (A: 53.1%, B: 60.6%). Reflective-journal analyses showed that AI functions shifted from ideation and structuring in the outline stage to genre-requirement checks in the introduction, evidence and argumentation reinforcement in the body, and summarization and style editing in the conclusion; overall, partial adoption of AI suggestions predominated, but both high reliance and minimal use were observed in the final stage.

title_ko: 텍스트 마이닝을 활용한 AI 기반 중국어 교육 연구 동향 분석

abstract_en: This study examines the evolution of artificial intelligence applications in Chinese language education through text mining analysis of 41 research papers published between 2000 and 2024. Our findings reveal three distinct developmental phases: a theoretical exploration period (2016-2020), initial field application attempts (2021-2023), and a recent period of accelerated growth centered on generative AI technologies (2024). Word frequency and network analyses identified "artificial intelligence," "chatbot," and "Chinese language education" as predominant research keywords, with significant emphasis on personalized learning approaches utilizing generative AI tools such as ChatGPT. However, when compared to research in English language education, this field demonstrates notable limitations in research volume, topic diversity, and empirical validation. Our analysis suggests that future research should prioritize diversification of research domains, enhancement of empirical methodologies, and expanded investigation of educational contexts and ethical considerations specific to AI implementation in Chinese language instruction.

title_en: A study on the application of machine translation in undergraduate translation classes in the AI era: Focusing on in-depth interviews in a Chinese-Korean translation class
kw_en: ChatGPT; Translation education; machine translation; AI translation; translation competence
abstract_ko: This study investigated the integration of machine translation (MT) and artificial intelligence (AI) into undergraduate translation education, focusing on how these tools support translation competence and language skill development through a social constructivist approach. Conducted in a Chinese-Korean translation class, the research analyzed how students improved their translation abilities using a collaborative machine-human model. Students utilized Papago and ChatGPT as key tools in their translation tasks, enhancing vocabulary, grammar, and sentence structure skills while developing cultural knowledge and translation competence. Team-based learning and classroom discussions played a crucial role in helping students refine machine-generated translations and acquire effective strategies. ChatGPT provided immediate feedback, fostering an interactive learning dynamic that boosted confidence and motivation. The findings highlight that integrating MT and AI into undergraduate courses can significantly improve translation quality and collaborative learning. This approach supports both individual skill-building and collective growth, demonstrating the potential of combining technological advancements with traditional translation education.

abstract_ko: This study examines Chinese-Korean machine translation texts generated by NAVER Papago in 2021, 2022, and 2023, analyzing them for changes in error frequency, and patterns, and reviews undergraduate students' post-editing cases. This study also suggests modifications to the Chinese-Korean post-editing guidelines proposed in previous studies, particularly regarding message, lexis, and structure. Suggested modifications ask for greater allocation of attention on cross-referencing the source text with the machine-translated text, including giving greater consideration for the target audience, conducting thorough research, and comprehending the subject matter. Further suggestions include explanations and examples in the guideline to aid translators distinguish non-errors from actual errors.

abstract_en: The purpose of this article is to discuss the meaning of college reading education in the age of artificial intelligence, and to think about the meaning of reading education in college liberal arts education in the age of artificial intelligence and to explore its educational direction. Although it is not a face-to-face classroom, students participate in non-face-to-face remote video classes, listen to special lectures by experts in related fields, and have an active opportunity of interactive communication by asking questions directly, providing an opportunity to enhance academic achievement can do. title_ko: 생성형 AI를 활용한 중국어 변형 구조 문장의 생성 연구
title_en: A study on the generation of transformed Chinese sentences using generative AI
kw_ko: 중국어 쓰기 교육; 생성형 AI 활용 쓰기 교육; 중국어 변형 구조
kw_en: Chinese writing education; writing education utilizing generative AI; Chinese transformed structures; 漢語寫作敎育; 生成式人工知能寫作敎育; 漢語變形結構
abstract_ko: This study examined how 16 Chinese transformational structures are generated using generative AI from the perspective of learners whose native language is Korean. To summarize: (1) In weak AI models, using the zero-shot input method, Baidu generated 13 transformed Chinese Sentences, and Papago generated 11 transformed Chinese Sentences. (2) In strong AI models, using the prompt input method, WRTN generated 12 transformed Chinese Sentences, and Yuanbao generated 11 transformed Chinese Sentences. The possible reason why weak AI showed better results than strong AI may be because the analysis target was simple sentences. Baidu and Papago AI are programs specialized in translation. Therefore, under the same conditions as the experiment, it can posited that weak AI is more specialized than strong AI. Thus, it may be sufficient to utilize weak AI in current Chinese writing education. Nevertheless, for this research be applicable to Chinese writing education, the following additional analyses are necessary: (1) This study targeted ‘simple sentences.’ If applied to ‘complex sentence’ writing education, an analysis of whether weak AI remains useful is necessary. (2) An analysis of how to conduct education using Artificial Intelligence is required.
